The pending mandate already performed the reset: it SUPERSEDEd the parent oracle-repair handoff (B4) in favor of B2, matching the audit priority order ('B4 - OPEN but no longer the unique critical path'). The claim_streak=68 on C-MEAS-VALID and the tunnel_flag are exactly why this supersession matters and it must be honored: runtime's role is to follow important central blockers, not to acquire a permanent micro-specialty. Asymmetric discovery (multi-task sessions where one-time session/resource/schema discovery is amortized) is a genuinely different substrate class from the deterministic REST families that tied cold at the 1.0 ceiling, because cold is expensive in requests even when correct, giving cost-based dynamic range; if that class also cannot be certified, that bounded negative is itself the decisive answer that the flagship benchmark needs a different substrate.
